conditions.condition_text: Mark out the high and low of the most previous candle, including the wick, on the 1H timeframe.
This defines the initial range for the CRT setup.
Wait for price to break the defined high or low, and then for the candle's body to close back inside that range (reversal confirmation).
The reversal of the candle body inside the range confirms the initial break was a false move.
Wait for the third candle to form a complete U-shaped reversal to the opposite end of the initial range.
This confirms the market's intent to move from one extreme to the other.
Mark out the high or low of the second candle (the one that broke and reversed).
This sets the boundary for the entry trigger on the lower timeframe.
Enter on the break of the middle candle's high (for longs) or low (for shorts) on the 1M timeframe.
The break of the middle candle's high/low on the lower timeframe serves as the final entry trigger.
